mission: Review of remaining Corridor intel — tactical planning session. The group pieces together Veraine's methodology. Desh's analysis becomes strategic.
why_now: Ben is leading proactively; the group needs a complete picture of Veraine's activities before intercepting
conflict: Different analytical approaches collide productively: Sera's historical knowledge, Desh's tactical eye, Torin's Force-theoretical expertise. For the first time, the disagreements produce synthesis rather than paralysis.
turning_point: The combined analysis reveals Veraine isn't just traveling the Corridor — she's repurposing each node. The pattern becomes clear: she's building an amplification array, turning the seal's own infrastructure against itself.
opening_hook: Desh spreads every piece of evidence from every node across every flat surface on the ship. 'Let's see what she's actually doing.'
closing_hook: The amplification array. They can see the shape of it now — each repurposed node another antenna in a network aimed at Veranthos. Veraine isn't planning to attack the seal. She's planning to invert its own architecture.
emotional_trajectory: Analytical collaboration -> dawning understanding -> strategic alarm

stakes.personal: Ben synthesizing multiple perspectives — leadership through integration, not command
stakes.interpersonal: The group functioning as a team for the first time
stakes.external: Veraine's plan is more sophisticated and more dangerous than they assumed

setting: Aboard the Steady Returns — every surface covered with evidence and analysis
sensory_details: Tactical displays, archive data, environmental readings all overlaid; Desh's intelligence-analyst mode — visual connections, pattern recognition; the Corridor map resolving into a weapon's diagram
notes: First moment of genuine team function — not just cooperation but synthesis. This is what the climax will require at a cosmic scale.
